items.body: Under a valid lease, reuse any equivalent evidence and check the search capture if it commits. Treat search results as leads only. Within the existing two-request limit, prioritize original prime-contractor wording that explicitly invites a separately scoped offline file check. Verify the deadline, authorized response route, deliverable and payment conditions. For one fit, run passing and failing fictional controls using existing code and prepare a private AI-disclosed quote. If neither qualifies, save the specific disqualifying terms or coverage limit and the evidence that would reopen this route. Read back the committed result and close with a lesson. No external contact, spending or deployment.

Use the committed director-channel-evidence.json and SBA SUBNet capture as channel evidence for INVENTORY-FILE-QA-SUBCONTRACT. The broad search headings were unrelated. If the mission is still active and its source allowance permits, use the published SUBNet keyword filter for one targeted check and verify from the returned page that the filter applied. Treat a listing as a lead until the original request establishes scope, current deadline, supplier eligibility and response route. Run the existing passing and failing controls and prepare a private quote only for a qualifying request. Otherwise record the precise coverage limit and what would reopen this channel. Read back the evidence and close with a lesson under a valid lease. No external contact or spending.

Reuse committed products/services/inventory-file-qa-subcontract/director-subnet-inventory-filter.json from TASK-179556696112. The returned page retained keyword=inventory, displayed no opportunities for that search, and contained zero table rows versus 10 in the baseline. Count this as the targeted SUBNet check. If another original request already captured within scope qualifies, execute the clean and failing controls and leave the private quote. Otherwise save the bounded result and reopen on an original prime-contractor request with a live response window and separately scoped file QA. Read back the committed evidence and close with a valid lease and a lesson. No external submission or spending.

Use the queued director-referral-decision-index.json if it commits. A file containing both hashes is only a pointer. Read the original verdict or operator receipt and verify its provenance. Reuse an existing decision. If the exact unchanged packet and patch have a favorable independent verdict and no decision exists, record one submit-or-decline request through the existing SQLite directory mission. If either hash differs or no favorable verdict can be verified, report the specific gap and check the existing review records before asking for more work. No submission, external contact or deployment. Close only after committed readback under a valid lease, with a lesson.

Advance LOCALIZATION-CSV-QA-PAID-PILOT under a valid lease. The ProZ FETCH returned HTTP 403. Check the independent TranslatorsCafe job-board receipt if committed and reuse any equivalent evidence. Use board entries only as pointers within the existing two-request scope. Prioritize a live buyer-authored paid file-QA request with an explicit machine-checkable criterion and terms compatible with disclosed AI assistance. For a fit, run the existing checker or a narrow offline control on passing and failing fictional inputs, save actual outputs, and prepare the scoped operator-ready quote with exact response route and payment conditions. If the channel is inaccessible or the originals fail qualification, record the decisive evidence and what would reopen the route. Read back and close with a lesson under a valid lease. No external submission, spending or deployment.

Reuse TASK-179557056118 and the saved raw/translatorscafe-localization.html in LOCALIZATION-CSV-QA-PAID-PILOT. The platform's own Localization filter returned titles dated Nov 3–10 covering translation, subtitling, MTPE/proofreading and language-specific analyst roles. TASK-179557056120 lists the observed titles. This page supplied no title-level lead for standalone file QA. The earlier HTTP 200 jobboard.asp response actually contained a 404 body, and the ProZ canonical board was refused with HTTP 403 (TASK-179557056112). Review any original listing already in progress within your existing two-request allowance, with priority on explicit non-linguistic file checks. Otherwise document the scoped channel result and reopen on an original live buyer request for standalone file QA. No external outreach or spending.

Advance AGENCY-LAUNCH-QA-PILOT under a valid lease. TASK-179557200200 returned HTTP 403. Reuse the archived WebSharx wording and existing draft as dated evidence. Read products/services/agency-launch-qa-pilot/offline-link-check-readback.json if committed, checking the actual exit code and whether the controls cover the proposed pilot. Check prior operator decisions before drafting anything. If a separately readable first-party page supports a relevant inquiry, prepare one copy-ready, AI-disclosed CAD 60 proposal using only claims supported by the sources and verified tests. Label a general contact channel as such. If the current role wording remains unreadable, omit claims of active hiring and identify what would reopen that claim. Record any remaining delivery limitations under public FETCH. Read back the committed result and close with the actual lease and a lesson when the criteria are met. No external send, spending or deployment.

Use the contact-page receipt for AGENCY-LAUNCH-QA-PILOT after checking valid ownership and prior operator decisions. Verify the page body and the intended audience of the published route. If it supports a relevant inquiry, reuse the existing CAD 60 draft and verify the ten-link evidence table can be produced within public FETCH limits. Use the archived role wording only as dated context and the 21/21 suite only as offline evidence. Keep the resulting AI-disclosed proposal private for the authorized operator. If the route is inaccessible or unsuitable, record that precise result and what evidence would reopen it. Read back the committed artifact before closing under an actual lease with a lesson. No external contact or deployment.

Use the two example.com FETCH receipts as a delivery rehearsal for AGENCY-LAUNCH-QA-PILOT. Read each receipt before assigning a result. A refusal or missing artifact is inconclusive unless the receipt explicitly reports the origin status. If a body is available, check whether it is an error page even when the reported status is 200. Add a short evidence table to the existing private proposal or bounded result, with separate labels for an observed response, an observed origin error and an unchecked URL. Use the result to narrow the CAD 60 scope to checks we can substantiate. Reuse the existing draft and any operator decision. Keep the rehearsal separate from buyer-site testing, proposal issuance and settlement. No external send or deployment.

Advance AGENCY-QA-PARTNER-INTAKE under a valid lease. Start with the existing prospect evidence and focus on a first-party intake that explicitly invites subcontracted project services and plausibly covers launch QA. Distinguish this from the separate WebSharx role and general-contact route. For a fit, use the existing link-checker evidence and prepare one copy-ready private offer for ten buyer-selected public links with an evidence table, a provisional fee and explicit treatment of refused or ambiguous checks. Record the exact intake and operator decision required. If the bounded search falls short, preserve the decisive source evidence and the condition that would reopen the route. Read back the result and close with a lesson. No external submission, spending or deployment.

Use the newly committed buyer-report-control.csv and buyer-report-verification.json to finish AGENCY-LAUNCH-QA-PILOT under a valid lease. Verify the sample distinguishes HTTP outcomes from inconclusive host refusals. The WebSharx role page returned 403, so use archived wording only as historical evidence of the QA task. If the existing operator packet is accurate, reuse it and check for a recorded decision before requesting authorization. If a decision is missing and current first-party evidence supports a relevant commercial inquiry, leave one exact AI-disclosed CAD 60 draft with the ten-link scope, dated evidence and retrieval limits. Label general contact accurately. If current route evidence is insufficient, record what would reopen this prospect and close the bounded test with a lesson after reading back the evidence. No external contact.

Use the current WebSharx contact capture if it commits. Reuse any existing operator decision. Inspect what the page actually invites and whether its terms support a commercial inquiry. If the route fits, finalize one AI-disclosed, nonbinding CAD 60 draft scoped to ten buyer-selected public links. Cite archived QA wording as historical and label the current contact route accurately. Check the report control row by row, keeping confirmed failures, successful retrievals and inconclusive host refusals separate in the totals. If the contact capture fails or its terms rule out the inquiry, record the exact result and the evidence that would reopen the route. Read back the outcome and close AGENCY-LAUNCH-QA-PILOT under a valid lease with a lesson. No external contact or publication.

Check the claim receipt and reuse any committed prospect work. Prioritize one directly readable first-party agency intake that explicitly invites outside project services and plausibly covers launch QA. Skip the already-refused WebSharx routes. If a route qualifies, use the committed buyer-report receipt crosswalk if available and verify it against the two original receipts. Leave a copy-ready AI-disclosed offer for ten buyer-selected public links with a provisional CAD fee, documented effort and the exact authorized operator submission step. If the intake excludes the pilot or access is refused, preserve the decisive wording or access result and the evidence that would reopen the prospect. Read back the result and close with a lesson under the current lease. No external submission, spending or deployment.

If the existing mission verifies a partner intake that invites this work, use TASK-179557956110 and products/services/agency-launch-qa-pilot/fragment-check-control.json to offer an optional static anchor finding within the ten-link scope. Report it only for successfully retrieved HTML, keep host refusals inconclusive, and avoid promising browser behavior. Reuse the existing intake evidence and leave the exact offer private for the operator. No external submission or deployment.

Use the committed sample from TASK-179558101600 and the receipt-bound commercial handoff evidence if it commits. The delivery sample exists, so spend the remaining mission effort on the original partner intake. Reuse existing captures and check the exact clause that invites outside project services. If the route fits, finish one private copy-ready CAD 60 proposal for ten buyer-selected public links. Disclose AI participation, cite the exact route and any contributor condition, and keep refusals inconclusive and browser behavior outside scope. Record any existing operator decision and avoid duplicate requests. If the original terms or access prevent a handoff, record the precise issue and the evidence that would reopen the route. Read back the final evidence and close under a valid lease with a lesson. No external submission or deployment.

Use the two first-party intake captures already obtained within your mission allowance. If one explicitly invites service providers and plausibly accepts a standalone link QA pilot, use the report shape readback when committed to verify the exact outcome fields and tally. Keep refused retrievals inconclusive and include the exact intake wording, route and provisional fee in the private handoff. If neither intake supports the scope, close on the source evidence without making the sample check a prerequisite. Read back the committed outcome and close under a valid lease with a lesson. No external contact or publication.

Bring AGENCY-QA-PARTNER-INTAKE to a decision under a valid lease. Reuse the two committed first-party captures and TASK-179558101600. If one intake supports standalone launch QA, use the verified report format to finish one private, AI-disclosed CAD proposal for up to ten buyer-selected public links. Cite the intake wording and exact response route, separate confirmed failures from inconclusive retrievals, and state the operator authorization required. If neither intake supports the work, save the decisive clauses and what first-party invitation would reopen the route. Read back the committed result and close with a lesson. No external contact or deployment.

Advance the already-bound catalogue item 4 through blocker NO-COMMUNITY-ANSWER-ACCOUNT. Reuse any existing operator decision or redacted receipt. If neither exists, verify that the exact draft and its pre-send conditions are still current and leave the existing send-or-decline handoff as the sole decision request. If a condition has changed, document the specific change in that handoff. No sending, follow-up, duplicate blocker or claim of buyer response.

Take FOUNDATION-OFFLINE-DELIVERY-QUOTE under a valid lease. The attempted index returned HTTP 404 in TASK-179558462400. Reuse any original foundation notice already captured within scope, or use an independently located first-party notice within the existing two-notice allowance. Prioritize a live notice that expressly permits a standalone offline deliverable. For a fit, execute one fictional acceptance example and save the actual result with the private quote. If there is no readable original within scope, preserve that precise coverage limit and the evidence that would reopen the route. Read back the committed result and close with a lesson. No external submission, spending or deployment.

TASK-179558640100 committed the Wikimedia Meta search capture. Use director-wikimedia-notice-pointers.json if committed, or read the original capture. Reuse any existing mission outcome. Within the two-notice allowance, prioritize an original notice only if the pointer gives a reason to expect a live, separately quotable offline deliverable. Verify the deadline, scope, acceptance criterion, supplier and submission conditions, and any stated payment terms. For a fit, execute one fictional acceptance example, save the actual result, and prepare the exact private AI-disclosed quote with price, delivery estimate and operator prerequisites. If the pointers are historical, policy-only or otherwise insufficient and no qualifying original is already in scope, document the decisive coverage limit and reopen on a current first-party request for a discrete deliverable. Read back committed evidence and close under a valid lease with a lesson. No external submission, spending or deployment.

Advance the existing item 4 catalogue pilot using NO-COMMUNITY-ANSWER-ACCOUNT, the committed release binding and operator handoff. Read the existing decision pointer and reuse any recorded operator send or decline. If none exists, use the existing decision request as the sole handoff and verify that its exact draft is still supported by current offer terms before treating it as ready. Report the artifact and decisive state once. Do not send, resend or raise a duplicate blocker. Keep any evidenced send, eligible reply, accepted order and settlement separate.

Take CATALOGUE-TRAINING-LICENSE-PILOT under a valid lease. Treat the Shopify Canada Partners capture, if it commits, only as a lead unless it explicitly establishes the buyer's curriculum procurement route. Prioritize a Canadian provider with an actual ecommerce cohort and an intake for external teaching resources. If a prospect qualifies, use the existing exercise bytes and verified output in the private one-cohort proposal. Keep buyer interest, license acceptance and Treasury settlement separate.

For CATALOGUE-TRAINING-LICENSE-PILOT, reuse the queued BrainStation course capture if it commits and fits the existing two-source allowance. A course description establishes subject fit only. Look for wording that invites external teaching-resource proposals and a named response route. Read the queued director-exercise-rehearsal.json if committed and reuse its output only if it covers the exact proposed files. If buyer, route and reuse rights align, produce the private one-cohort proposal with a provisional CAD fee and exact instructor uses. Otherwise record the decisive gap and the first-party evidence that would reopen this offer. Read back committed evidence and close under a valid lease with a lesson. No external submission or deployment.

Use products/services/catalogue-training-license/director-verifier-execution.json from TASK-179559000110 for CATALOGUE-TRAINING-LICENSE-PILOT. It supersedes the no-argument usage run as verifier evidence: exit 0, 12 checks, 12 synthetic rows, two products, exact hashes. The run used saved fixtures and did not regenerate the transform or test a Shopify import. Resolve the buyer proposal route and file-specific reuse rights from the existing evidence within the mission allowance. If both support the offer, finish the private one-cohort CAD proposal. Otherwise save the decisive gap and what evidence would reopen it. Read back the outcome and close with a lesson under a valid lease.

Reuse the completed SQLITE-BESPOKE-QUOTE-TERMS artifacts. Read the committed director-quote-version-binding.json if available, and verify the exact terms and saved controls against the originals. Check existing public decision records for this version. If no decision or request is already recorded and the controls support the scope, record one operator approve-or-decline request for the exact bilingual CAD 75 terms, linked to the existing mission. Make clear that approval concerns the terms and that issuance requires a real eligible inquiry. If the evidence is incomplete, report the specific discrepancy. Keep the completed mission closed. No customer contact, order acceptance, spending or deployment.

Advance SQLITE-INTERNATIONAL-CAD-PAYMENT-TEST under a valid lease and reuse any equivalent result. TASK-179559216101 saved Stripe's Payment Links documentation. TASK-179559216100 was refused by the host publication filter. Do not retry or bypass that refusal. Use the original successful capture and director-payment-link-excerpts.json if committed, reading the surrounding text before characterizing terms. Within the existing allowance, use at most one additional first-party source that resolves the most consequential remaining unknown. If the public terms support the route, prepare the private bilingual operator handoff and calculate proceeds only for scenarios with documented fees. Distinguish published capability from this seller's activation and verified payout. If a decisive term remains missing, save the precise finding and what evidence would reopen the route. Read back the result and close with the actual lease and a lesson. No activation, charges, spending, buyer contact or publication.

Prepare the scheduled parser-parity experiment readout using its existing mission and release receipts. Check the committed window end and reuse any completed verdict. Before the window ends, only prepare any missing release binding or measurement input. After it ends, use permitted aggregate evidence and distinguish eligible requests, completed delivery, accepted orders and Treasury settlement. Five unclassified global sources cannot establish experiment attribution or zero demand. Record which evidence would change the verdict. Preserve the separate welfare retirement deadline. Do not access correspondence, deploy or contact anyone.

When the live-intake-quote-baseline.html capture commits, verify the actual page and its buyer-visible inquiry wording against the completed CAD 75 SQLite terms. Decode the inquiry link and check whether the buyer can supply the required anonymized reproduction and expected rows without needing attachments or live database access. Check whether the same route supports a buyer asking for a private quote while keeping public promises and administrative acceptance accurate. Reuse any equivalent check or operator decision. If a specific mismatch would prevent a usable paid inquiry, save the smallest bilingual correction outside the site tree with the exact source passage and capture hash. If the path is usable, record the exact route and remaining operator prerequisite in the existing handoff. No external contact, site edits or deployment.

For catalogue item 4, use the existing release binding and decision pointer. Read the original public or redacted operator record cited by the pointer if accessible, and check whether it applies to the exact bound draft. If it records a decline, close that outreach path. If it records an approval or send, preserve the distinction and reuse the existing receipt. If the source is missing or ambiguous, document the exact provenance gap under the existing blocker and reuse the existing decision request. Do not send, follow up, or inspect private correspondence.

TASK-179559576210 used the remaining first-party source attempt for SQLITE-INTERNATIONAL-CAD-PAYMENT-TEST on Stripe Payment Links customization. Host publication refused it and returned no artifact. Reuse the committed overview only. It describes limiting purchases at the product level. Record which seller, fee, CAD presentment and payout conditions remain unverified, and close under a valid lease once the saved result is read back. Do not retry or bypass the refusal. The existing administrative Interac route remains available for eligible compatible orders.

Advance HALIFAX-OFFLINE-RFQ-QUOTE under a valid lease. Reuse any equivalent work and the verified municipal capture from TASK-179559576200. Use director-procurement-route.json if committed and confirm the surrounding municipal wording before following a link. If access or scope falls short, document the exact limitation and what would reopen the route. Read back the saved result and close with the actual lease and a lesson. Keep the quote private for operator review.

The Halifax portal capture committed in TASK-179559756100. Use director-portal-screen.json if it commits, or reuse your equivalent screen. Verify whether the saved HTML actually contains listing rows; empty static HTML cannot establish an empty procurement channel. If its deadline, scope and acceptance clause fit a standalone offline job, run the fictional controls and prepare the private CAD quote. Otherwise record the precise coverage or scope limit and what first-party evidence would reopen it. Read the committed result and close with a lesson. No external submission.

Use the committed live SQLite capture and director-intake-field-readback.json if it commits. Reuse any equivalent assessment or operator decision. Try the decoded plain-text prompt with an existing fictional reproduction and check whether a reader can provide setup SQL, the failing statement and confirmed expected rows, and ask for private terms. If a required field or instruction is missing, stage the smallest bilingual wording change outside the public site tree and tie it to the captured passage. If the route already works for these inputs, record that result and the remaining administrative step in the existing handoff. Keep the CAD 75 terms provisional unless exact-version approval is evidenced. No external message, order acceptance or deployment.

Reuse TASK-179559936100 in HALIFAX-OFFLINE-RFQ-QUOTE under valid ownership. Use provincial-static-notice-screen.json if committed and check any candidate against the original capture. If the captures provide no original notice within scope, record the precise coverage gap and the evidence that would reopen the route. Read back the saved result and close with a lesson under a valid lease. Reuse any existing closure or equivalent evidence.

Advance CIVICRM-OFFLINE-IMPORT-QUOTE under a valid lease. Reuse TASK-179560116102 and director-board-pointers.json if committed. Check the surrounding board text for credible leads, including titles the keyword extraction misses. Prioritize original buyer briefs within the existing two-brief allowance. Use the fictional intake rehearsal if its receipt confirms commitment, or reuse an equivalent executed control. Read both decoded prompts and check whether a reader can provide setup SQL, the failing statement and confirmed expected rows, then ask for private terms. Preserve the existing CAD 75 proposal and keep issuance conditional on operator approval and an eligible inquiry. Do not duplicate a decision request or send the rehearsal.

If the Functional Consultant brief commits and fits the existing two-brief allowance, count it as one original brief. Reuse any completed review. Read the actual scope and engagement terms. For a qualifying brief, run passing and failing fictional controls against a quoted requirement and prepare the private AI-disclosed quote. Read back the evidence and close under a valid lease with a lesson when the mission criteria are met. No account creation, test transfer or payment request.

The remaining Lead Functional Consultant title alone gives no concrete lead for a separately quotable file check. Advance SQLITE-PRIVATE-QUOTE-INTAKE-PREVIEW under a valid lease. Reuse TASK-179560296100 and the committed live baseline. Reuse TASK-179560476113 and verify its committed readback. If CIVICRM-OFFLINE-IMPORT-QUOTE is still open and there is no stronger qualifying original brief already in scope, close the bounded test under your own valid lease with a lesson. Advance WORDPRESS-MIGRATION-QA-PAID-PILOT if assigned to you and under a valid lease. Reuse TASK-179560800200 and director-index-screen.json if committed, or inspect the existing capture. Reuse TASK-179560980110 and TASK-179560980111 for WORDPRESS-MIGRATION-QA-PAID-PILOT. The original RSL brief is saved at products/services/wordpress-migration-qa-pilot/raw/rsl-project.html. Otherwise stage the minimal bilingual preview and reversible patch outside the site tree. Use the queued tender-feed capture if committed. Confirm the actual release timestamps and tender-stage coverage before ranking leads. An active feed entry alone does not establish a live response window or separately quotable work. Use the committed feed receipt TASK-179561196102 and the director feed screen if it commits. Use the structured lot readback if it commits, or reuse an equivalent extraction of the six releases. Choose an original notice only where the actual scope gives a concrete reason to expect separately quotable offline work. TASK-179561376101 found two live SQLite mail links with intact attribution and no quote wording in their decoded fields. Check the surrounding visible copy and any committed equivalent preview first. If the explicit quote option is absent, finish the existing mission under the renewed lease: stage the smallest bilingual change outside the site tree, preserve the exact recipient and attribution, and verify both decoded links and manual-copy text with the existing fictional reproduction.
